rationale: The four author purposes need matched passages and digital versions; medium icons cannot show added/removed evidence.
Youth enthusiasm is analysed through imperative, address and sound; a cheering scene would label emotion instead of demonstrate the wording.
Bet-story character dimensions require actual descriptions and reactions; an invented portrait or filled map would supply unsupported traits.
Added labelled double-pane sealed-gap section; reduces heat transfer not complete prevention, independently source checked.
The market lesson targets sensory word choice. A generic stall would impose a place/product and cannot show how the quoted promise creates anticipation.
The giant-grain recording asks for audible pace, pauses and inference; an oversized grain picture would only illustrate the title.
Market speaking asks the student to choose a real market and reliable evidence; a stock market image would choose content without modelling delivery.
Energy-saving explanatory writing leaves the chosen method and supporting evidence open; a supplied causal chain would choose that argument for the student.
The three sentence examples already expose statement/command/question in their words; an education icon cannot teach the rhetorical distinction.
Paper-illness plot requires actual events on a curve; no concrete sequence is given, and a completed curve would pre-answer climax selection.
Education-price evidence needs a sourced statistic or argument, neither supplied numerically; a salary chart would invent support.
The existing writing/library/recycling/digital chain is an oversimplified source sequence. Do not reinforce it as universal causal history in a new diagram.
Printing listening compares arguments by evidence and delivery; a printer photo cannot establish which spoken view has stronger support.
Volunteering presentation leaves the chosen real act and example open; a handshake image would select an unmentioned activity rather than support delivery.
Paper/electronic reading comparison is the student writing task; device/book pictures repeat the two labels without supplying a sound matched comparison.
Prayer order is rhetorical priority, not physical process; a security-to-food flow would imply a stronger causal claim than the language analysis.
Homeland sunrise is figurative hope, not geographic dawn; a landscape photograph would literalize the symbol before textual inference.
Hope/despair opposites are stated, but the target is comparison of actual poems; another antonym box would repeat labels without matched verse evidence.
Hassoun character viewpoint depends on neighbours reactions and the story ending; a fictional magician portrait would invent appearance and omit evidence.

Named tower photo could anchor appearance but the candidate carries UAE architectural copyright warning despite photographer license. No photo used; it cannot establish the missing source statistics and a silhouette would be an unverified substitute.
Existing added wind-tower airflow schematic directly explains wind capture and room circulation; separately verified and live inspected.
Qasr Al Hosn is an audio-tone task here. A building photograph would identify the site but not explain emotion, pacing or pauses.
Creativity recording asks for claim/evidence comparison; a lightbulb would be a topic proxy with no support for a particular spoken argument.
Heritage-festival talk asks students to choose a festival and evidence; an unselected event image would imply the teacher model concerns that event.
Giving/belonging narrative requires the student lived scene and conflict; a finished storyboard would choose the original details and ending.
Persuasion text types require matched advertisements/articles/proverbs; a generic ad card without real wording would not demonstrate the argument.
Wisdom comparison needs the actual two sayings and their context; an elder portrait would stereotype wisdom rather than show concise language.
The proverb lesson contrasts original tale and use context; an invented historical scene would imply details absent from its brief summary.
A horse stumbling would literalize the proverb and narrow its transfer to skilled human error; lamps would only illustrate the metaphorical title.
Hudham oral tale lacks grounded appearance or setting; a portrait would invent identity and cannot show trust in her words.
Added source-checked male sandgrouse belly-feather water-carrying sequence, not beak transport or speculative anatomy.
The white-bull recording focuses on voice and inferred conduct; a predator scene would preselect the event and interpretation before listening.
Arabic-proverb talk requires a student-selected proverb and story. A generic heritage scene would select neither reliable evidence nor speaking technique.
Cross-cultural proverb comparison leaves both examples open; supplied paired scenes would choose student content and could invent cultural equivalence.
Added public-domain Met ney photo, visibly identified as Iranian late19th-century example not poet instrument.
Bint Bin Dhaher biography explicitly acknowledges oral variation; an invented portrait or dated timeline would harden uncertain heritage details.
Madame Perronets two birds are a viewpoint task, not species identification; an invented bird pair would add appearance without revealing actual reactions.
Pet persuasion must weigh benefits and responsibility; a cute pet image would bias the opinion while providing no evidence for reduced stress.
Added labelled cup/sphere/tunnel nest shapes, no species assignment or scale implied, Cornell source checked.
Volcano recording weighs hypothetical arguments, not an eruption process; an eruption photo would dramatize the topic without supporting the audible claims.
Endangered-animal presentation leaves species selection and source evidence to students; a supplied animal would choose their subject prematurely.
Book/film comparison requires a matched real scene, neither supplied here. Generic camera/book art would repeat medium labels.
Mother letter is analysed through address, question and prayer; a mother portrait would impose private appearance and cannot show rhetorical intent.
Eid joy is inferred from repeated words and the running-with-birds image. A literal flying child would misread it and a festive scene would preselect interpretation.
Mother-hospital story has a stated surprise; an accident illustration would disclose the reveal and add ungrounded injury details.
Added two-state reciprocal rope-coil comparison using source labels your vessel/parents vessel; visible literary analogy limitation.
The motherhood generalization includes seahorses and cannot be safely expanded into a universal biological visual; an elephant image would conceal that distinction.
Grandmother recording asks for pace and emotion, not a portrait; an invented elderly figure would label family role without giving sound evidence.
Gold-lira recording requires listening to character actions and emotion; a coin photo cannot establish those motives or outcomes.
Family/community speech leaves family examples open; a stock family image would impose membership and distract from organization and delivery.
Family-device research requires a question and documented evidence; a family-on-phones photo would suggest a conclusion before research.
Added clearly labelled schematic format samples; no invented real content or automatic classification claimed.
The camel adaptation is already explained accurately in words, but a desert collage would duplicate habitat labels; no extra scene needed beyond possible targeted later anatomy work.
Added source-checked ostrich head lowered to eggs not buried, visibly schematic without exact anatomy or novel scene.
Gazelle recording targets audible emotion and pace; a gazelle picture would merely identify the animal, not support sound analysis.
Mirage listening weighs spoken arguments. A desert shimmer image cannot establish whether a particular audible claim is well supported.
Desert-animal speech leaves species and adaptation choice to students; an animal collage would select examples without teaching delivery.
Cages/nature discussion must weigh competing claims; a confinement photograph could bias the open opinion rather than supply balanced evidence.
Animal-habitat persuasive writing needs sources and counterclaims; a fixed cage-versus-savannah pair would impose the conclusion and species.
Novel prediction explicitly starts from its real cover; an invented child-with-ostrich scene would replace that evidence and pre-answer the prediction.
Novel character map is assigned but supporting figures and relations are not supplied; a filled network would invent content.
Narrator viewpoint needs an actual passage and pronouns; two face icons cannot show what is known, hidden or reinterpreted.
Desert/inner/flock conflicts need exact difficult moments. A child-survival scene would invent an episode and take over the classification task.
Narration/description/dialogue require a matched novel excerpt; an empty speech balloon would repeat a category without showing textual technique.
Desert/ostrich symbolism is interpreted beyond literal meaning; a wildlife photo would not explain the evidence for freedom or belonging.
Choosing climax and predicting resolution is assessed; a completed curve would decide the inference before students support it.
Changing the desert setting is a counterfactual reading question. A forest replacement would select a scene not in the novel and imply an answer.
The ending is compared with student predictions and alternatives. A fixed reunion scene would narrow the possible reading and add unsupported events.
Character development needs a specific starting trait, changing moment and final evidence; no filled sequence can be sourced from this framework alone.
Adaptation compares an actual chosen scene with performance. A ready storyboard would choose the scene and omitted details for students.
Diary/alternate ending/critique/presentation choices remain open. A completed visual project would privilege one product and bypass student planning.
